marginNote: Sell ex GST = net invoice ex GST × (1 + margin%/100). Inc GST = ex GST × 1.10.

parse.notes: Excel row 6 is typically the column header row; ingest skips header-like rows. All workbook sheets are scanned; product sheets yield priced parts.

admin.note: Admin unlock compares a password attempt to a baked-in PBKDF2 hash in the app bundle (no plaintext in config). Session unlock uses sessionStorage. Admin UI writes local overrides + a change queue; production catalogue updates go through AI / npm run ingest, not by rewriting prices.json from the browser.

documents.note: Binary PDFs stay under localFolder (gitignored). Vite maps rootUrl → ./data-sheets for http. file:// builds (dist/index.html) use fileRootUrl → ../data-sheets. Open PDFs via link/navigation, not fetch. Index JSON only is committed.

howToRefresh: Drop the new Rinnai price workbook into source-data/ (or update priceList.workbookPath / priceList.endpoint in this file).
Update priceList.effectiveDate and priceList.workbookFile/workbookPath/endpoint to match the new file.
Run: npm run ingest (authoritative production catalogue). Admin browser import is a local overlay + change-queue intent only.
Restart or refresh the app — search uses public/data/prices.json and public/data/models.json (plus localStorage admin overlays).
Series aliases (HD28 ↔ VCM2837 etc.) are hand-maintained in public/data/series-aliases.json — not overwritten by ingest.
Trade aliases (flow servo → WATER FLOW SENSOR etc.) are hand-maintained in public/data/trade-aliases.json — not overwritten by ingest.
Data-sheet PDFs: keep under data-sheets/ (e.g. C:\Temp\rinnai-spare-parts\data-sheets\). Index stays available in code; main search UI no longer lists sheets.
Tech sheet refresh: npm run sync:tech-sheets -- --mirror <path-to-rinnai-tech-latest> (map in public/data/tech-sheet-sync.json). Use --index-only to rewrite document-index.json without copying PDFs.
Part-name abbreviations (public/data/part-name-abbreviations.json) apply at search time to every catalogue name — including newly priced parts — and are not overwritten by ingest.
Admin flag/suspend/delete/import: localStorage overrides queue intents for AI ingest sync — do not treat browser edits as the production source of truth.
